mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 1.0% in 60% of periods but 60-day returns negative in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months but 5-day returns positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both rise but 20-day returns negative in >50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial slowdowns (INDPRO declining), manufacturing output contraction reduces earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline occurs but 60-day returns positive in >50% of industrial slowdown periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL rising >0.3pp in 3 months) triggers monetary tightening expectations, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 3 months but 5-day returns positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth positive in 60% of periods but 20-day returns negative in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During housing booms (HOUST above 1200 thousand units), strong residential construction signals economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1200 thousand units but 60-day returns negative in >50% of housing boom periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO falling <100 over 3 months) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls < 100 in 3 months but 5-day returns positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
